items.title: Treasurer promises to 'fix' property tax oversight, but won't say how exactly
items.description: The Treasurer is promising to "fix" an unintended consequence of the government's overhaul of property tax breaks to protect widows and divorcees — but he has refused to say exactly how.

items.title: How tourists and plastic transformed Bali into an 'Island of Trash'
items.description: Known to many as the Island of the Gods, residents fear Bali may soon become the "Island of Trash" due to a deluge of tourists, a lack of rubbish education and the partial closure of a much-needed landfill facility.

items.title: Australian accused of Thai teen's murder tells her family 'I feel bad'
items.description: An Australian man charged with the murder of a 17-year-old girl in Thailand tells her family her death was "out of my control".

items.title: Bahrain and Kuwait targeted in Iran strikes as Hormuz tensions spike
items.description: It comes after the United States says it launched fresh strikes on Iranian military infrastructure near the Strait of Hormuz "in direct response to continued Iranian aggression against commercial shipping".

items.title: Brisbane man makes fastest human-powered Everest ascent from sea level
items.description: Avalanches, altitude sickness, orcs and Justin Bieber — a Brisbane mountaineer is believed to have set a new world record on Mount Everest for charity, despite every obstacle thrown his way.

items.title: Live: No Messi, no problem as Argentine star scores belter

items.title: Venezuela earthquake death toll passes 1,400 as survival window narrows
